extracted.rawText:
Noah Osei
noah.osei@example.com | Tampa, FL
Noah Osei has 12 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Ironwood Networks (2025-2026), where they
introduced Terraform-managed infrastructure, cutting provisioning time by 75%.
Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Meridian Labs (2022-2025). Before that,
Backend Engineer at Grayline Software (2018-2022). Before that, Software
Engineer I at Palodex Systems (2014-2018). Education: Ph.D. Computer
Engineering, DePaul University, 2014; B.S. Computer Engineering, University of
Maryland, 2008. Core skills: PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, REST API design, AWS,
Kafka, Distributed systems, Node.js, TypeScript, Go, Terraform.
